newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Allianz next in China - Winterthur.
newsitem.headline: Allianz next in China - Winterthur.

text.p: Winterthur Insurance Co believes Allianz Versicherungs AG will be the next foreign insurer to get a license for doing business in China, an official said.
"I think Allianz will be the next. We have knowledge about the fact that Allianz will be next," the official said, pointing out that German President Roman Herzog was now visiting China.
"I think there is a great need for him to come back with such a license for Allianz," he said.
Winterthur today got the final license to conduct non-life business in the greater Shanghai area. -- Zurich +41 1 631 7340
